page.overview:
Who is Cassida Previn?

Archmage Cassida Previn was one of the wizards of the city of Aeor, and a member of the Society of Primes. As an NPC, Cassida is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

When first seen in Trist's vision of the person who had recently prayed to The Everlight in the abandoned temple within Aeor, Cassida was wearing the high-collared dark cloak of an archmage of the city.

Cassida grew up in the Opus Ward, a working class neighborhood where she witnessed a lot of deaths due to unsafe working conditions, and worked her way into becoming one of the elite wizards of the city. Her upbringing gave her a firm belief in the gods, and she also believed she could help to end the Calamity by saving the Prime Deities. She devoted her life to this project, becoming a wizard of intense focus and dedication.

She was one of three archmages who held enough knowledge of the Factorum Malleus project to be able to recreate it.
